name: The Cascades, Bowling Green Bay NP
description:
The Cascades, Bowling Green Bay NP
Sunday, September 15, 2024
Led by Ian Wallace

Rated - Level 5 . Difficult. Recommended for experienced
bushwalkers. Rugged terrain, undefined route.
Duration - 12 kms, This walk is estimated to be a 7-9 hour day.
This is one of the club’s classic Palm Creek walks and it features terraced cliff faces where the falls cascade over rocks. This is a visual treat- waterfall after waterfall.

There is a lot of steep scrambling and climbing and creek based
walking.

name: Black Hole Falls, Paluma Range NP
description:
Black Hole Falls, Paluma Range NP
Sunday, September 8, 2024
Led by Wilfred Karnoll

Rated - Level 5 due to how steep it is and how long the walk is. This walk is for moderately fit bushwalkers.
Duration - This walk is estimated to be a 6-8 hour day.

The Black hole was discovered by members of the Townsville Bushwalking Club and named by Luen Warneke (wanderstories.space). On aerial imagery you see a dark image of the deep pool of these falls which is how the name came about.

This beautiful hike is varied in it’s landscape and vegetation.
We start at the base of Jourama falls and climb through the ranges to reach Black Hole falls.

RSVP: TBWC Members- Free. Visitors/Guests- 5$ ( All welcome, you can become a member after 3 walks

name: Bluegum Ck
description:
***𝐓𝐇𝐈𝐒 𝐖𝐀𝐋𝐊 𝐈𝐒 𝐀𝐓 𝐂𝐀𝐏𝐀𝐂𝐈𝐓𝐘***

Where -  The Blue Gum Circuit 
Led by - Cherry Judge

Rated- 3. For the moderate level bushwalker. Due to the elevation change a moderate level of fitness is encouraged ie you should be doing regular exercise that makes you puff.

Terrain type - On Track hike. Creek crossings. The track ascends  and descends steeply  - about 400 m elevation (approx 2 Castle Hills). 
Duration ( approx) of walking per day - about 5 hours. Anticipate being back in Paluma village by 2-3 pm

Distance covered ~ 11 kms

Meeting place - will be emailed to those that have RSVPd

About the walk:
The Blue Gum Creek is on the south side of Paluma Village and is a day walk that takes you on a loop across Blue gum Creek, Star Valley, past Triple Falls and Old Wolfram mines. The Blue Gum Creek hikeis mostly on bush tracks in the forest.There is some creek rock hopping at the bottom of the valley.
We will be stopping at Triple Falls for a quick break before we head down to Blue gum valley and check out the lagoon on Bluegum creek. 
Lunch will be at the Miner Creek Falls. 
You will get to see some of the old tin mining era relics in this area, especially around Miners creek and falls. 
For detailed info - check out Wanderstories: https://bit.ly/47qVcLA

What to bring on the walk - https://bit.ly/wtbdayhike

name: TBWC Meet & Greet and Walk Talk
description:
TBWC Meet & Greet and Walk Talk
